label: Vercel
agentGuide: Me: GET /v2/user; teams: GET /v2/teams (add ?teamId=<id> to every call made for a team). Projects: GET /v9/projects (projects[] with id, name, framework, link); one: GET /v9/projects/<id or name>. Deployments: GET /v6/deployments?projectId=<id>&limit=10 (uid, state, url, createdAt, meta.githubCommitMessage); one: GET /v13/deployments/<id>; its build logs: GET /v2/deployments/<id>/events?builds=1. Environment variables: GET /v9/projects/<id>/env (values hidden), add: POST /v10/projects/<id>/env {"key": "...", "value": "...", "target": ["production"], "type": "encrypted"}. Domains: GET /v9/projects/<id>/domains. Redeploy: POST /v13/deployments {"name": "<project>", "deploymentId": "<previous id>", "target": "production"}. The token is set by Allkin.
